entities.name: Q086A7
observations: Exact 159-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q086A7 from Shewanella frigidimarina; annotated as 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodiphosphate synthase (IspF), EC 4.6.1.12.
Catalyzes CDP-ME2P conversion to ME-CPP and CMP; assigned to the MEP isoprenoid pathway, requires one divalent metal cation per subunit, and is annotated as homotrimeric.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 16,873 Da and theoretical pI 5.51.
